        except Exception as exc:

    # Look for Python files that might be tasks

            id=fpath.stem,
            description=f"Run {fpath.name}",
            setup_instructions=f"python {fpath.name}",
            files={fpath.name: fpath.read_text()},
        ))

    ws_path = Path(workspace)
    ws_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    for task in tasks:
